The non-negotiable rules rule out five pieces of heavy infrastructure in the early phases: PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR and multi-country support. Rule 11 says no complex infrastructure without a real need. Rule 13 adds that AR, IFC and enterprise come only after commercial validation.

ANSWER_PATH: 02_PRODUCT/projects/workspaces/casa3d/app/CONSTITUTION.md
ANSWER: Rule 11: "Fără infrastructură complexă fără nevoie reală (fără PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR, multi-țară în fazele timpurii)." In English: no PostGIS, IFC, AR, OCR or multi-country support in the early phases.
